name: mememo
description: Code-aware memory MCP server: store/recall memories, index repos, semantic code search, typed call/import graph (CALLS/IMPORTS/EXTENDS across 14 languages), and comprehension tools (ask with citations, overview, generate_wiki). Private, local, torch-backed embeddings. Requires the `mememo` package installed first: `pip install mememo` (pulls torch + sentence-transformers — heavy download on first run).
